feature_definitions.class_loc: Non-empty physical lines in class/struct/record excluding nested types.
feature_definitions.class_logical_loc: Total executable statements and expression bodies across owned class members.
feature_definitions.method_count: Number of direct method declarations in the type.
feature_definitions.constructor_count: Number of direct constructors (including primary constructors).
feature_definitions.property_count: Number of direct property declarations in the type.
feature_definitions.field_count: Number of direct field variable declarators in the type.
feature_definitions.nested_type_count: Number of direct nested class/struct/record/interface declarations.
feature_definitions.total_parameter_count: Sum of formal parameters across direct callable members.
feature_definitions.max_parameter_count: Maximum parameter count among direct callable members.
feature_definitions.total_local_variable_count: Sum of local variable declarations across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_statement_count: Sum of statement AST nodes across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_return_count: Sum of return statements and expression bodies across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_cyclomatic_complexity: Weighted Methods per Class (sum of McCabe complexities, minimum 1).
feature_definitions.mean_method_complexity: Mean McCabe cyclomatic complexity across direct callable members.
feature_definitions.max_method_complexity: Maximum McCabe cyclomatic complexity among direct callable members.
feature_definitions.std_method_complexity: Population standard deviation of McCabe complexity across callable members.
feature_definitions.max_nesting_depth: Maximum lexical control-flow nesting depth across direct members.
feature_definitions.mean_nesting_depth: Mean maximum nesting depth across direct callable members.
feature_definitions.total_boolean_operator_count: Sum of !, &, |, ^ operators across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_logical_operator_count: Sum of &&, ||, ?? short-circuit operators across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_if_count: Total if statements across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_switch_count: Total switch statements and switch expressions across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_loop_count: Total for/foreach/while/do-while loops across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_try_catch_count: Total try-catch-finally blocks across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_throw_count: Total throw statements and expressions across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_break_continue_count: Total break and continue jump statements across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_method_call_count: Total method invocation expressions across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_assignment_count: Total assignment expressions across direct members.
feature_definitions.total_object_creation_count: Total explicit and implicit 'new' object creations.
feature_definitions.static_method_count: Count of static methods declared in the type.
feature_definitions.async_method_count: Count of async methods declared in the type.
feature_definitions.generic_method_count: Count of generic methods declared in the type.
feature_definitions.high_complexity_method_count: Count of callable members with cyclomatic complexity >= 10.
feature_definitions.large_method_count: Count of callable members with loc >= 40 or statements >= 25.

labeling_methodology.positive_label: 1 (Defect-prone class): Mapped via SZZ (git blame -w -M -C) from heuristic bug-fixing commits on production C# files to the innermost enclosing class/struct/record in the pre-fix parent revision.
labeling_methodology.negative_label: 0 (Candidate-clean class): Substantive production classes sampled from HEAD files with zero recorded bug-fixing commits or SZZ traces in the mined commit window, interpreted under the Open-World Assumption (not confirmed defect-free).
labeling_methodology.leakage_and_filtering: All test directories, test fixtures, build directories (bin/obj), and auto-generated files are excluded via is_production_csharp_file().
